title: Splines and Operators: Part II - Resolution of Inverse Problems
summary: We present a unified treatment of the data-fitting problems with quadratic (Hilbertian) regularization that arise in approximation theory, machine learning, engineering, and statistics. The generic problem is an optimization in the continuum: given $M$ linear measurements of an unknown function, one minimizes a convex data-fidelity term that is penalized by $\|\mathrm{L} f\|^2_{L_2}$, where $\mathrm{L} $ is a differential-like (spline-admissible) operator.
